say:1:1821208001:1.text: Novaris doesn't even have sunlight... I feel like a flower slowly withering away...
say:1:1821208001:1.source_cn: 诺珐斯竟然没有太阳，感觉我像一朵花一样枯萎了……

say:2:1821208002:1.text: If I'd known, <sad>I never would've volunteered to transfer to Novaris just for the better pay!</sad>
say:2:1821208002:1.source_cn: 早知道的话，<sad>我就不该为了高薪主动申请调来诺珐...
